definitions.explanation: The act of writing down words spoken by another person, often as an educational exercise.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は{書取|かきと}りテストがある。
examples.english: Today's class has a dictation test.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{読|よ}んだ{文章|ぶんしょう}を{書取|かきと}りする。
examples.english: I will take dictation of the sentences the teacher reads.

examples.japanese: {書取|かきと}りは{漢字|かんじ}の{練習|れんしゅう}に{役立|やくだ}つ。
examples.english: Dictation is useful for practicing kanji.

notes:
EDUCATIONAL CONTEXT: Commonly used in Japanese schools to test and practice kanji writing skills.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{書取|かきと}りテスト (dictation test)
・{書取|かきと}りの{練習|れんしゅう} (dictation practice)
